crossRefs.note: Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
May Yahweh therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of…
“But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
But, Yahweh of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for…
Their Redeemer is strong: Yahweh of Armies is his name. He will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to…
Therefore Yahweh says: “Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea, and make…
I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case, and executes…
My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the…
My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.

translations.web: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
translations.bsb: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
translations.kjv: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
translations.asv: Plead thou my cause, and redeem me: Quicken me according to thy word.
